forum.title: STM32L073RZ LCD Configuration: CubeMX Cannot Assign VLCDrail1 to PB12
forum.best_answer_content:

forum.content_text:
I’m setting up a new project in STM32CubeMX for an STM32L073RZ using the internal LCD controller in 1/3 bias mode.

According to the STM32L0 reference manual (RM0367), the LCD voltage rails should be configured as:

PB12 - VLCDrail1

PB2 - VLCDrail2

![ECSL_0-1778435574858.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/926c5c41-dc9b-7c92-0bd3-bb423a8c6245.png "ECSL_0-1778435574858.png")

However, in STM32CubeMX, the GPIO configuration only allows:

PB12 - VLCDrail2

PB2 - VLCDrail2

![ECSL_1-1778435619125.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1d317868-2091-f9ba-e932-8597c981828c.png "ECSL_1-1778435619125.png")

![ECSL_2-1778435630027.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e7244f58-5d9d-1ccb-1297-f387b062352d.png "ECSL_2-1778435630027.png")

There does not appear to be any option to configure either pin as VLCDrail1.

Am I misunderstanding the LCD rail configuration for 1/3 bias mode on STM32L073RZ, or is this a limitation/bug in STM32CubeMX?

Thank you!

scraped_replies.html:
Hi Mahmoud,

 

Thank you. Is there any update on the ticket?

In the meantime, would it be sufficient to configure PB2 as LCD_VLCD2 and add this code after the LCD initialization?

GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct = { 0 };
	GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_12;
	GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
	GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
	GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_LOW;
	HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOB, &GPIO_InitStruct);

	__HAL_SYSCFG_VLCD_CAPA_CONFIG(SYSCFG_VLCD_PB12_EXT_CAPA_ON | SYSCFG_VLCD_PB2_EXT_CAPA_ON);
